screenshots.caption: All eleven displayed events match their expected outcomes, yet two consumers still need handoff. Matching event expectations does not mean every consumer switched.

Two consumers still acknowledge generation 1 while generation 2 is current. This prepared mismatch case also retains thirteen of fourteen matching outcomes; it does not relabel the wrong expectation as a pass.

observedTests.name: Independent distribution
observedTests.observed: All five downloaded release files matched provider hashes. The executable also matched its checksum sidecar. Installed resources remained byte-identical after actual use.

observedTests.name: Actual use and restart
observedTests.observed: All 12 installed workflows and 12 exact evidence bundles passed the original full assertions. Both launches exited normally; reopening retained every saved bundle.

observedTests.name: Source and security
observedTests.observed: All exact-source main workflows passed before publication. Configured processed CodeQL analysis had zero raw findings and zero open main alerts.

observedTests.name: Individual shortcut
observedTests.observed: Desktop and Start-menu targets were read back. Full installed executable acceptance is distinct from activating a normal default-profile shortcut.
